false_negatives.finding: The runner verifies that M1337 source hammer, M1338 launch release, and M1339 final hammer exist, then invokes the M1336 source-only checker. That checker's main unconditionally asserts all three future paths are absent. Therefore every correctly completed authorization chain deterministically fails before the license preflight and can never execute the promised one-shot run.

The sealed attempt receipt and successful candidate receipt bind runner, source contract, and launch-release SHA but omit the exact M1337 source-hammer and M1339 final-hammer review/manifest/outer SHA values consumed by the run. The future result package cannot independently reconstruct the complete authorization chain from its sealed receipts.

minimum_additive_successor: Split the static checker into explicit source-authoring and runtime-release modes. Source mode must require future artifacts absent; runtime mode must require them present and validate their exact externally supplied review/manifest/outer SHA bindings. The runner must invoke only runtime mode after the future chain is verified.

Add a no-EDA directed test using disposable future-chain paths that proves runtime mode passes with all three artifacts present and fails for each missing, mismatched, symlinked, or reordered authority.

Write the exact M1337 source-hammer review/manifest/outer SHA and M1339 final-hammer review/manifest/outer SHA into the sealed attempt, success-candidate, and failure receipts, in addition to runner/source-contract/launch-release identity.

Retain the exact K8/K1x8 2x5 cardinality and cycle/event anchors, same-UID/resource/license gates, DUT-only SAIF and endpoint-zero checks, success/failure double seals, renameat2 NOREPLACE, no retry, no ucli.key, exact PASS token, and all false performance/headline boundaries.
Obtain another different-author release-source hammer before authoring any launch release; do not execute license, VCS, simv, SAIF, or EDA from the source review.
